name: Sleepless Night
source: Another short visual novel about Haru. This time you team up with him to work on a school project. However, in this night something strange happens. Suddenly you're locked inside your own room and a dark power threatens your life! Can you find a way out of your room? Can you even survive this night? Pay attention to your environment and you might have a chance to escape.
translation: 又一部圍繞近松春展開的短篇視覺小說。這一次，你將與他組隊完成學校作業。然而，這個夜晚發生了怪事。你突然被鎖在自己的房間裡，一股黑暗力量正威脅著你的生命！你能否找到離開房間的方法？又能否活過這個夜晚？仔細觀察周圍環境，或許還有逃出生天的機會。
